title: custom values
description: Validates the fully merged values Helm-side (template defaults + user values + reconciler overrides). This is NOT the tenant-facing schema: the much smaller values_schema_json that drives the deployment form and hostname claiming lives on the DB product template — see products/custom/README.md.

hostname.title: hostname
hostname.description: User-supplied hostname. Hostname claiming reads the product template's values_schema_json, not this file; the title is mirrored here so the two schemas do not drift.

image.description: User-supplied image as "{user_id}@{digest}" (a digest reference with the registry host stripped), or empty to serve placeholderImage.

registry.description: Registry host that user images are pulled from

placeholderImage.description: System-owned image served while `image` is empty. Never user-supplied: it is the one image reference that bypasses the ownership assertion.

containerPort.description: Port the application is served on. Injected into the container as the PORT env var and targeted by the Service; tenant images bind $PORT rather than a fixed number. The placeholder image is pinned to the default.

objectStorage.description: Whether this chart wires up object storage (an S3 bucket, not a volume). A system value set by the product's catalog entry, never tenant-settable — it is deliberately absent from the tenant-facing values schema. Distinct from caelus.objectStorage, which carries the per-deployment references the reconciler injects.

relationalStorage.description: Whether this chart wires up a PostgreSQL database. A system value set by the product's catalog entry, never tenant-settable — it is deliberately absent from the tenant-facing values schema. Distinct from caelus.database, which carries the per-deployment references the reconciler injects.

caelus.description: Reconciler-injected values. Open by design (additionalProperties: true throughout): this namespace is written by the platform, never by a tenant, so new reconciler fields can land without a schema bump in every chart.

releaseId.description: Identifier of the rollout being applied, injected by the Caelus reconciler. Rendered onto the pod template as the caelus.dev/release-id label and relabelled by Promtail into a Loki stream label, so one release's output is selectable even while two rollouts' pods write concurrently. Empty when the chart renders standalone, in which case no label is emitted.

owner.description: Deployment owner, injected by the Caelus reconciler

id.description: Owning user id. The image ownership assertion compares this against the repository half of `image`.

objectStorage.description: Per-deployment object storage references injected by the Caelus reconciler. References only — the credentials live in the Secret named by secretName, never in values. The toggle is the top-level objectStorage.enabled, not here: that is a static product declaration, these are per-deployment runtime facts. Optional throughout: a product that has not opted in gets an empty object.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret the reconciler writes into this deployment's namespace, projected into the app container with envFrom.

database.description: Per-deployment database references injected by the Caelus reconciler. References only — the password lives in the Secret named by secretName, never in values. The host and port address the pooler, which is the only route a tenant pod has to a database. The toggle is the top-level relationalStorage.enabled, not here. Optional throughout: a product that has not opted in gets an empty object.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret the reconciler writes into this deployment's namespace, projected into the app container with envFrom. It carries DATABASE_URL and the discrete PG* variables.

vars.description: Runtime configuration injected by the Caelus reconciler, as a reference only. The values live in the Secret named by secretName and never in values, which are logged and persisted. Absent entirely when the applied release carries no vars, so no envFrom source is rendered.

secretName.description: Name of the Secret holding this deployment's vars, written into its namespace before Helm runs and projected into the app container with envFrom, ahead of every platform-provided source.

ingress.description: Ingress and per-app TLS settings injected by the Caelus reconciler
